subject: Request: Waive packaging surcharge for Horizon Health pilot
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@horizonhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging surcharge for pilot — request to waive

Marissa / Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Horizon is excited to spin up the pilot. Before we sign the SOW the procurement team pushed back on a one-time "packaging surcharge" line item ("Onboarding & Packaging" $48,000). Their argument: as this is a time-limited pilot with a capped spend and restricted internal budget codes, the surcharge skews the unit economics in the first year and will make the business case harder to justify to the board.

Quick context: projected first-year spend across environments (pilot + initial rollout) is ~$1.2M. We agree to a 12-month commit and can prepay on invoice, but procurement asks that the packaging surcharge be waived or converted into a credit applied against usage over the first 3 months.

Can Redwood make an exception? If needed, we can do a one-page MOU to capture the concession terms and commit. I've attached the renewal projections for your review (Horizon_Renewal_projections.xlsx).

Appreciate any flexibility — our implementation timeline is tight and this is the only thing holding us up.

Best,
Sara Patel
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Horizon Health

[Attachment: Horizon_Renewal_projections.xlsx]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Packaging surcharge for pilot — request to waive

Team — forwarding Horizon's ask. Short summary and suggested path:

- Ask: waive $48k onboarding/packaging surcharge OR convert to month-1 credit.
- Commitment: 12 months, ~$1.2M ARR first-year expected, willing to prepay.
- Risk/benefit: small near-term revenue hit vs strategic account + likely multi-year expansion (they've indicated intent to roll to 3 additional departments if pilot goes well).

I drafted an exec memo we can use for signoff and for Finance to create a credit-backed invoice if approved (attached: exec_memo_packaging_waiver_draft.docx).

Proposed concession (what I think we should ask VP/CFO to sign off on):
- Waive the one-time packaging surcharge (48k) and convert to a 3-month usage credit applied to their first invoices; OR
- If Finance prefers, leave surcharge on contract but apply an immediate invoice credit and collect standard 12-month commit (prepay ok).
- Requirement: signed MOU / DocuSign that lists the 12-month minimum commitment and standard support terms.

Request: Markus / Marcus — can you review and provide approval (or alternate commercial terms) by EOD so we can get this to Horizon and lock the pilot launch window?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: exec_memo_packaging_waiver_draft.docx]

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging surcharge for pilot — request to waive

Marissa — thanks for the concise memo. High level: I'm willing to approve a concession here given Horizon's scale and the likelihood of multi-product expansion, but want firm commercial guardrails. My conditional approval: 

1) Waive the $48k packaging surcharge entirely, convert to a usage credit applied over the first 3 monthly invoices.
2) Require a 12-month minimum commitment at the agreed pricing band; Horizon must sign the MOU and we must receive either a prepayment for the first 3 months or a signed PO from Horizon's procurement team prior to waiver taking effect.
3) No other changes to T&Cs; standard SLA and data controls remain.

Marcus (cc'd) — finance, please confirm treatment for revenue recognition and credit accounting (do we record as contra revenue or an invoice credit) and confirm whether we need a separate internal approval to waive the surcharge line item for accounting.

Marissa/Sean — once Finance confirms, Marissa please issue the MOU and DocuSign flow; I'll sign the exec memo and route to Marcus if needed.

-Markus
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

On Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 10:02 AM marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Horizon's ask. Short summary and suggested path...

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Packaging surcharge for pilot — request to waive

Sara — good news. Following review with Sales leadership and Finance, Redwood will grant a one-time exception for Horizon on the packaging surcharge with the conditions below: 

- Waiver: the $48,000 packaging/onboarding surcharge will be waived and converted into a usage credit applied across the first 3 monthly invoices.
- Commit: Horizon to sign a 12-month MOU and deliver either a signed PO or prepayment covering the first 3 months before the credit is applied.
- Accounting: Finance will treat the credit per standard contra-revenue practice; invoice will reflect the credit line.

Next steps: I've sent the MOU to your contracts mailbox via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/placeholder/HVN-2024-0917. Once we receive the signed MOU and PO (or payment), Finance will proceed with invoicing and Marcus will confirm accounting treatment.

Thanks for working with us on timing — excited to get the pilot going.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
